description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Revocation, the notification Published in Gaz.Ex.No. 1841/04 and 1847/37
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the revocation of previous legal notifications under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008. The content specifically deals with the rescission of statutory instruments published in previous Gazette Extraordinary issues, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Mahinda Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance, this is in the context of exercising statutory authority rather than describing his portfolio responsibilities or making a personnel appointment. The core subject matter is the modification of legal instruments, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
